This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to drive excellence in patient care, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance within a dynamic healthcare environment.

As the VP of Clinical, you will be instrumental in shaping clinical strategy and ensuring the highest standards of care are met across all facilities. This is a chance to make a significant impact on patient outcomes and operational efficiency, supported by a competitive compensation package that includes a bonus structure and potential for higher pay for an exceptional candidate.
requirements: Active clinical license (e.g., Registered Nurse) in the state of Oklahoma
Minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in a multi-site healthcare setting
Demonstrated expertise in clinical operations, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance
Strong strategic planning, communication, and team development abilities
Bachelor's degree in Nursing or a related healthcare field; Master's preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $120,000 - $140,000 per year plus bonus, with potential for higher pay for the right candidate based on experience and qualifications.

description:

description:
We are seeking an experienced Regional MDS Coordinator to oversee the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process across multiple skilled nursing facilities in the Oklahoma City and Tulsa regions. This pivotal role ensures accurate and timely resident assessments, compliance with regulatory standards, and optimal reimbursement.

This is an urgent opportunity offering a competitive annual salary of $100,000 - $110,000 plus bonus. We are prepared to offer higher compensation for the right candidate who brings exceptional experience and expertise to our team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator, with multi-facility or regional experience preferred.
RAC-CT certification highly preferred.
Thorough knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid regulations and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process.
Ability to travel regularly between facilities in the OKC and Tulsa areas.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary of $100,000 - $110,000 plus bonus, with potential for higher compensation for exceptional candidates.
